passage: Leap years. That's where it went wrong. I'm Trisha, I'm twenty-two, and my hardest moment in my first month as team lead was about a date parser. Thursday, hostel.
Fest is in nine days and our registration page crashed again. Jeevan built the whole thing himself last year: the form, the database, even the emails. Tonight I said, gently, "The college's standard form tool does all this. And it doesn't crash." He looked at me like I'd insulted his family. "Mine has custom colours. And that tool isn't ours." He stayed up till 3 patching it.
I get it. I watched him build it. He skipped the Goa trip for it. But I'm starting to think he's defending the three weeks, not the page.
Tomorrow I'll ask him: if we were starting today, what would we pick? Maybe a question lands better than my opinion.
Nikita
